review.images: Reviewed the Emaar project hero and ten gallery assets. Omitted the narrow crop of the hero. Used the wide project image for the listing card and retained the home interiors.
review.location: Matched the named Emaar collection point and the plot diagram on physical brochure page 11. Verified the four times on the original Emaar fact sheet via Petkovic Properties.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all ten physical pages, excluding the cover and broker contact page. Matched 36 individually labelled imperial totals across all eight original residence sheets. The sheets list unit totals without component breakdowns.

unavailable: Individual home coordinates and signed unit areas were not verified. A complete developer-hosted plan pack was not verified.
